svg.title: SoL-Pi finishes at 1,127 cycles and $60.11; single Sol at 1,333 cycles and $39.20; stock Pi swarm at 1,366 cycles and $82.12
svg.desc: All three trials share a zero to 120 minute time axis and an inverted logarithmic cycles axis. Faint points are correct submitted candidates, open circles are accepted commits, and step lines hold the best accepted result. Four invalid stock-Pi candidates appear in a separate row. The cost box reports model-specific API-equivalent USD estimates.
svg.text: Filled points: correct candidates · Open points: accepted commits · Lines: best accepted so far
